title: Root compromise anomaly detection and quarantine absent (spec 02a 2a.5.5.3)
description: Requirements: R-02a-067 (MUST) nodes MUST implement defenses against root key compromise / malicious root behavior; R-02a-068 (SHOULD) monitor anomaly indicators (>100 SFN epoch jump without version change, >60 s drift when GNSS-PPS flag was set, slot_map excluding all previously active nodes, beacon rate >150%); R-02a-069 (SHOULD) log anomaly with beacon hash + increment per-root counter; R-02a-070 (SHOULD) >3 anomalies in 5 min demote trust (stratum +1); R-02a-071 (SHOULD) >10 anomalies quarantine root until manual intervention / OOB verification. Classification: not-implemented — grep for anomaly|quarantine|demote across python/src, rust, lichen/subsys returns zero hits. Rotation/revocation halves of 2a.5.5.3 are tracked separately in project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.28. Suggested placement: per-root anomaly counter beside candidate evaluation (py slot_coordination.py MultiRootState; rust multi_instance.rs; C tdma.c when b7z9.24 lands); demotion hooks into stratum ordering already present (py timing/stratum.py:304-330). From spec-coverage sweep 2026-08-31 (docs/spec-coverage.md R-02a-067..071).
